title: Bridge Metrics Consolidation Review
purpose: Review MPF-PALG-041 through MPF-PALG-049 as a coherent metrics scaffold and determine whether bridge metrics are safe for continued analog-only use.
review_findings: Bridge metrics successfully quantify trace quality without source identity claims.
Loss differential clarity metrics prevent collapse into false complementarity.
Conflict preservation is rigorously enforced as a mandatory indicator.
Coherence scores are successfully constrained to analog alignment only.
Recoverability bounds effectively block source-relation reconstruction claims.
Drift detection provides an automated linguistic firewall against physical overreading.
Safety composite index streamlines governance by combining all indicator types.
remaining_risks: High safety scores may psychologically invite 'proven' language in informal contexts.
Metric thresholds may require refinement under diverse projection scenarios.
Loss differential granularities remain qualitative and dependent on manual audit completeness.
forbidden_next_steps: Promote bridge metrics to physical evidence.
Use safety index to bypass manual governance gates.
Claim QM/GR unification based on coherence scores.
